hook.text_top: A whole football stadium inside a car tire.
hook.voice: A whole football stadium inside a car tire.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance 2.0.

shots.label: The look
shots.excerpt: Hyper-realistic miniature macro photography, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, warm golden late-afternoon sunlight casting long dramatic shadows.
shots.voice: The look. Miniature macro with tilt-shift blur. That one phrase makes everything feel tiny and real.

shots.label: The setting
shots.excerpt: MUST SHOW: the full miniature stadium inside the tire ring, two big banners on the upper stands, tiny fans and a white minivan on the wooden table.
highlight: white minivan on the wooden table
shots.voice: The setting. Must show the stadium inside the tire ring, plus tiny fans and a van on the table for scale.

shots.label: The camera
shots.excerpt: One continuous take, no cuts. The camera slowly orbits clockwise around the tire and gently pushes in and down.
shots.voice: The camera. One continuous take with no cuts, starting with a slow clockwise orbit.

shots.label: The dive
shots.excerpt: The camera accelerates over the rim of the tire and plunges down into the stadium, rotating slightly, with fast motion blur on the stands.
shots.voice: The dive. The camera plunges over the rim into the stadium, with motion blur selling the speed.

shots.label: The descent
shots.excerpt: The camera swoops low over the stands behind one goal and glides forward just above the grass toward the centre circle.
shots.voice: The descent. It swoops behind the goal and glides just above the grass toward the players.

shots.label: The duel
shots.excerpt: Low-angle macro side view at grass height, the two players facing each other in slow motion; the ball stays between their boots as they jostle.
highlight: the ball stays between their boots
shots.voice: The duel. A low macro angle at grass height, in slow motion, with the ball locked between them.

shots.label: The secret
shots.excerpt: Behind them the packed stands curve around, the black tire tread rises as the upper wall, blue sky above.
highlight: the black tire tread rises as the upper wall
shots.voice: The secret. The tire tread becomes the stadium wall, so you never forget where you are.

outro_voice: The full prompt is in the caption. Follow Mira AI for a new one every day.
